description: phase-tree-port (overview-data-split Phase 3): port the entire phase tree section (plans/overview.html lines 1920-2009) into OVERVIEW_DATA.phaseTree[] with a rich node schema that handles both task-linked bullets (task-ref) and structural bullets with no task id (raw, for 1b.1, 4a-4m, etc.). planReviewContext.description: phaseTree[] tagged union ({kind: 'task-ref'|'bullet'|'sub-phase'}) is insufficient for identical rendering. plans/overview.html lines 1920-2009 use .phase-grid, .phase, .phase-head, .item-name with state classes 'open|deferred|donefade|closed', nested <details class="phase-subdetails">, and inline styling. Tagged union can preserve structure but not the state classes or arbitrary inline content.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Use a richer node schema. Each phase: {id, title, headerHtml?, nodes: [{kind:'task-ref'|'raw', taskId?, state?: 'open'|'deferred'|'donefade'|'closed', html?}, ...], subPhases: recursive}. 'raw' carries trusted inner HTML; 'task-ref' carries taskId + state. Render emits the appropriate class names on .item-name.

Phase tree authored HTML is 1920-2009. Use these verified ranges when deleting / inserting.

generatedAt and generatedFromCommit are top-level fields on OVERVIEW_DATA (NOT wrapped under meta:{}). The consumer at plans/overview.html line 3540 reads data.generatedFromCommit at top level. Do not move these fields when populating phaseTree[].
